parent_policy: Unchanged observed_admission_completion control, not the rejected admission_structure, allocation_auction or reentry treatments.
evidence: The completed admission_structure treatment reduced pre-2026 wealth in all three core pools and was not selected. Its exact original controls were reconstructed on existing fills, with maximum target difference below 1.7e-16 and no alternative portfolio run. Mandatory positive-cap portfolio reductions involving more than one remaining holding occurred 4/0/6 times in union/common-five/joint-leader-removal; on 2/0/5 of those observations the higher original score also had a no-higher support-risk fraction. These counts establish decision freedom, not a return improvement. Older fixed four-position tests harmed returns/turnover, and observed gap-up admissions contributed substantial profits; neither a capacity expansion nor a no-chasing gate is proposed.
hypothesis: When a portfolio reduction is already mandatory, a proportional cut can reduce a stronger, better-supported position alongside a weaker, riskier position. Preserve more of the former only when the same liquidation amount and no-greater close-time support-distance risk can be retained. This is an economic allocation choice, not a claim that score predicts profits or that a marked risk budget bounds realized losses.
control: Exact original proportional reduction within observed_admission_completion, same construction-time Config, actual units, existing support estimates, entry and completion behavior.
treatment: Only at the original total-exposure reduction point, after all individual exits, existing quantity ceilings, single-name and sector reductions but before latching a newly created aggregate-reduction obligation, start with the exact proportional target. With exactly two positive remaining holdings, identify strictly stronger and weaker original Features.score. If both scores are finite and the stronger holding has no-greater max(close-stop,0.02*close)/close, transfer retained notional from weaker to stronger up to the stronger's pre-aggregate individual ceiling and the weaker's proportional retained notional. Equality of scores, missing data, a higher risk fraction, zero cap, one holding or more than two holdings leaves the proportional target unchanged. Do not optimize a new cutoff, fit a coefficient, add a holding or introduce a new ranking. Total retained marked value stays the same before existing conservative declaration rounding. Stop-distance risk cannot increase relative to the same-state proportional target.
obligations: No quantity may exceed the pre-aggregate individually protected target or actual holdings. Every prior per-symbol reduction ceiling, pending protective exit, stop floor, stale-quote exit, name/sector condition, mandatory portfolio cap and recovery condition remains binding. Never construct and then undo the original new per-symbol ceilings: allocate the new aggregate reduction before it is latched. All resulting declarations use the unchanged rounding and fill-aware obligation lifecycle. No protected close can buy; no sale proceeds are assumed; no actual-NAV history is reset; T+1, next-session/delayed execution, fees, limits, capacity and minimum amounts are unchanged.
implementation_boundary: Add one narrow protected-reduction hook to the existing support owner. Its default implementation must reproduce the former proportional arithmetic exactly; demonstrate equivalence against existing source-bound raw accounts, without rerunning an old grid. The specialized owner is constructed once before the first observation. Old experiment contracts and results remain immutable and bound to their original source; source hashes are not relabelled. Other entry/exit/allocator methods and the production package stay unchanged.
trace: Record signal date, actual inventory, pre-aggregate ceilings, original proportional target, selected target, prices, original scores, risk fractions, required marked-value target, before/after support-distance risk and whether the transfer was applied. Intent is not a fill. Preserve blocked and partial execution separately in the original order ledger.
selection: Exactly two declared candidates under the unchanged finite_study three-scope pre-2026 worst-deficit, objective and fills ordering. Preserve both raw outcomes. A selected control is not treatment success; no winner stitching across pools or retrospective candidate expansion.
evaluation: Evaluate the single selected candidate in the unchanged five windows. Original native references, original pools, contributor/industry removals, fixed subsets and sizes, costs/delays, neighborhoods, causal prefixes and actual risk-avoidance evidence remain required before main promotion. Core screening is not economic acceptance.
verification: same retained notional and nonincreasing support-distance risk
never exceed actual inventory or individual ceilings
old default arithmetic and control-account equivalence
pending individual protection and partial-fill retries
limitations: All inspected history including 2026 is retrospective. Raw findings and earlier failures remain retained. No reference source is imported; generic capital-allocation reasoning is implemented independently. Adjusted economic units are not a verified actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger.
